components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-width: 420px; background: var(--surface, #dbeafe); border: 1px solid var(--border-clr, rgba(23,37,84,0.3)); border-radius: 0; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 500ms; } .ds-card:hover, .ds-card:focus-visible { border-color: rgba(23,37,84,0.6); } .ds-card__media { aspect-ratio: 16/9; background: var(--surface-el, #bfdbfe); transition: transform 700ms; } .ds-card__body { padding: 24px; } .ds-card__head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card__title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-clash-display, 'Clash Display', sans-serif); font-size: 24px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--t-primary, #172554); } .ds-card__year { font-family: var(--font-satoshi, Satoshi, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--t-tertiary, rgba(23,37,84,0.6)); padding-top: 6px; } .ds-card__desc { margin: 0 0 20px; font-family: var(--font-satoshi, Satoshi, sans-serif); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--t-secondary, rgba(23,37,84,0.75)); } .ds-card__tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-card__tag { font-family: var(--font-satoshi, Satoshi, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border-clr, rgba(23,37,84,0.3)); color: var(--t-primary, #172554); }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio is a drafting sheet: Blueprint Navy and Drafting Ice laid over a fixed 50px grid. Every edge is square-cut and every rule is a hairline. Nothing is decorated that isn't also measured. The mood is technical and confident, but also minimal, editorial, and calm. Large Clash Display headlines carry the authority, and Satoshi body copy stays quiet underneath.

The play lives in motion, not in ornament. Text rolls up out of its line on hover, fills wipe up from the bottom, bars slide off headlines to reveal them, and a square difference-blend cursor tracks the pointer. At rest the page is still and flat; under the hand it comes alive. That contrast between precise stillness and responsive motion is the identity.

The two themes don't use two palettes. They are one palette inverted: dark mode is navy paper with ice ink, light mode is ice paper with navy ink. Depth comes from colour inversion, borders, and the grid, never from shadow, gradient, or glow.
keyCharacteristics: Strictly two-tone (navy and ice); the two swap roles between themes.
A fixed 50px drafting grid sits behind every page.
Hairline borders at 30% ink for structure, 10% for subtle division.
Flat at rest; hover states invert colour with an upward wipe.
One shared easing curve, `cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1)`, for all UI motion.
Brand fonts: Clash Display (headings) and Satoshi (body).

rules.name: The Two-Tone Rule
rules.body: Only navy, ice, and their opacity steps. No new hues, tints, or brand colours without exception.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: Emphasis comes from swapping paper and ink (navy on ice becomes ice on navy), not from adding a colour.

rules.name: The Weight-Drop Rule
rules.body: Inside a 600-weight headline, one key word may drop to 400 for emphasis. Never use italics or colour for this.

rules.name: The Section Marker Rule
rules.body: Every major section opens with the label strip: number, a 48px hairline, then the uppercase label at 0.3em tracking.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No shadows, glows, or gradients on surfaces. If something needs to stand out, invert it or give it a border.

dos: Do use only the theme tokens (`bg-background`, `text-text-primary`, `border-border`, `bg-accent`) so every component inverts correctly between themes.
Do keep every corner at 0px and every border at 1px Rule 30.
Do use the shared ease `cubic-bezier(0.33, 1, 0.68, 1)` and 300ms for hover state changes; save 500 to 700ms for card and image transitions.
Do express hover as inversion: an ink wipe up from the bottom, with the label rolling into paper colour.
Do open each major section with the Section Marker strip, then a Headline that uses the Weight-Drop Rule.
Do provide separate light and dark imagery wherever a screenshot or portrait appears.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: drop text rolls, reveal bars, and smooth scroll to instant state changes.
donts: Don't add any colour beyond navy, ice, and their opacity steps.
Don't use rounded cards, pill buttons, or rounded image frames.
Don't use gradients, glows, or glassmorphism as decoration. Blur is only for functional overlays (tooltips, lightbox, scrolled navbar).
Don't use the generic SaaS look: icon-in-circle feature grids, purple gradients, or floating shadowed cards.
Don't add drop shadows to surfaces at rest.
